messages:
Emma L (CSM): Quick weekly health check for AcmeCorp — saw an error spike overnight, putting this thread to triage the top failing endpoints and next steps.

Raj P (SRE): Thanks. I pulled the 24h window. Overall 5xx rate went from 0.4% -> 3.1%, timeouts (client-side) up ~4x, and rate-limited responses increased during a burst at 02:00 UTC.

Lucas T (Support): Customer reported slow responses around 01:50-02:20 UTC and one app-level retry loop. They attached logs: 
```
2025-11-10T01:51:03Z WARN request id=abc123 latency_ms=1480
2025-11-10T01:51:04Z ERROR request id=abc124 upstream_status=504
2025-11-10T01:52:10Z ERROR request id=abc200 backend_conn_timeout
```

Priya S (AE): Are these from their dedicated pool or hosted? They mentioned Dedicated, region us-west-2. Any capacity events?

Raj P (SRE): Dedicated pool. No node terminations in that timeframe. I see a sudden increase in long tails for chat endpoints — KV-cache miss rate jumped after a model rollback. Could be cold cache + heavier seq lengths.

Nora M (Product): Top failing endpoints per our logs (24h, by error count):
1) /v1/chat/stream — 48% of errors (mix of 5xx + timeout)
2) /v1/generate — 22% (mostly 5xx)
3) /v1/embeddings/batch — 17% (rate limit & timeout)
4) /v1/rerank — 8% (internal 5xx)
5) /internal/kv-sync — 5% (backend timeouts)

Emma L (CSM): Noted. Customer is onboarding a new product flow and their traffic profile shifted to longer contexts last night. They flagged renewal risks if this continues. We should propose immediate mitigations + a follow-up enablement + postmortem.

Raj P (SRE): Quick mitigation options: 
- Enable burst capacity on Dedicated for the customer for next 48h (adds +20% GPU capacity).
- Temporarily route chat/stream to a lower-latency model variant (smaller), reduce sequence length on requests.
- Increase timeouts at the SDK layer to avoid client retries compounding the problem.

I can open a scheduled reroute if folks agree.

Lucas T (Support): From support side: recommend a targeted customer-facing note with suggested client-side changes: reduce max_tokens, enable streaming to avoid large payloads, and add exponential backoff. I can draft.

Priya S (AE): Customer will accept a temporary boost if we cover costs for 72h — they're sensitive on renewal. Also request a 1:1 onboarding walk-through focused on prompts & batching.

Nora M (Product): Action items I suggest: 
- Short term (0-24h): Raj to enable burst capacity, route /v1/chat/stream to model-variant v2-small. Lucas to send customer guidance. Emma to set 1:1 onboarding slot.
- Mid term (3-7d): Telemetry: add context-length histogram per endpoint, KV-cache hit rate dashboard, and run a canary using v2-small.
- Postmortem: root cause analysis for the rollback/cache miss interaction.

Raj P (SRE): I'll open infra change now. Patch notes: 
```
change: enable_burst(acct=acmecorp, window=48h)
route: /v1/chat/stream -> model=v2-small (canary)
monitor: 1m error_rate, p95 latency, kv_cache_hit
```
Estimated time to take effect: ~7m after approval.

Emma L (CSM): Approved. Please keep me posted when the burst is live so I can inform the customer.

infra-bot: change request 8921 created by Raj P (SRE) — status: pending_approval.

Raj P (SRE): Update: change applied, burst enabled, routing rule active. Monitoring shows error rate on /v1/chat/stream down from 3.4% -> 0.9% in the first 12 minutes. P95 latency improved from 980ms -> 420ms.

Lucas T (Support): Drafted note to customer, please review: 
"Hi Acme team — we observed increased 5xx and timeouts overnight linked to longer context lengths on chat. We temporarily enabled burst capacity and routed chat to a smaller model to stabilize latency. Suggested client changes: reduce max_tokens to X, enable streaming, add 500ms jittered backoff. We'll follow up with a 1:1 enablement session. — Lucas"

Priya S (AE): Looks good. Add that we'll cover the burst cost for 72h and include a slot for the walk-through next Tuesday.

Emma L (CSM): I'll schedule the enablement and add the customer to our internal shared board (onboarding-playbooks/acmecorp).

Nora M (Product): For the mid-term dashboard: tagging action item for me and Raj to own KV cache telemetry. Will also schedule an eval to see if model rollback triggered parameter mismatch that caused cache evictions.

Emma L (CSM): Final ask: can we export the top 50 failing request IDs for the customer for their internal debugging? Lucas/Raj?

Raj P (SRE): Yes — exporting now, will drop in the shared folder.

Lucas T (Support): Export link: https://internal-storage.redwood/acme/acme-errors-1766204829.csv :thumbsup:

Emma L (CSM): Thanks team. I'll follow up after the enablement with a summarized status for the renewal owner.

Raj P (SRE): Closing the on-call loop — will keep watch for 24h, will escalate if error rate >1.5% sustained.

infra-bot: change request 8921 status: applied.

Priya S (AE): Customer responded: "Thanks — that stabilized things, appreciated the quick turnaround."

Emma L (CSM): Great. Marking this thread resolved for weekly check-in. We'll still do the postmortem for the cache/rollback interaction. :white_check_mark:
